t: The Stanley FatMax Classic Black 5m Tape Measure is a highly durable manual measuring tool designed for precise layout work. Ideal for busy construction sites, carpentry workshops and daily trade use, this Class 2 tape measure features a 32mm wide steel blade with both metric and imperial scales for easy reading. A 3m standout reach allows for efficient single-handed measurements, while the Mylar-coated blade and BladeArmor coating on the first 7.6cm significantly reduce the risk of breakage. The impact-resistant rubber case and corrosion-resistant 3-rivet true zero end hook ensure long-lasting reliability. A slip-resistant cushion grip provides enhanced comfort and secure handling during extended use.
b: Mylar-Coated Steel Blade with 3-Rivet True Zero End Hook
